---
title: "05_sample_submission_form"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

This script is for making a sample submission form for the library for Genewiz.

First, pull in the i5 and i7 information specific to your library. The file below has the i5 and i7 names and sequences that Genewiz will need for demultiplexing.

```{r}
index_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data","raw","sample_submission_form_template.xlsx"), sheet = 2, skip = 1) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  select(i7_index_name, i7_index_sequence,i5_index_name,i5_index_sequence) 

i7_indexes <- index_data %>%
  select(i7_index_name, i7_index_sequence) %>%
  distinct()
  
i7_indexes %>%
  count() 

i5_indexes <- index_data %>%
  select(i5_index_name, i5_index_sequence) %>%
  distinct()

i5_indexes %>%
  count() 
```

Next, import the lib prep file after it has been filled out by the lab team.  An example is provided below. 

```{r}
file <- here::here("data","raw","example_lib_prep_completed.xlsx")

data <- excel_sheets(file) %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(~ read_xlsx(file, sheet = .x))
```

```{r}
combined <- bind_rows(data[as.character(1:20)])
```

Filter out the rows with NA (which would be the PCR blanks)

```{r}
comb_filt <- combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(ind_id))
```

Add a sample_num 

```{r}
info <- comb_filt %>% 
  mutate(sample_num = row_number())
```

Ok, need to change the CVTRIV to have the 25 after CV [won't be the case for your data]

```{r}
info <- info %>%
  mutate(ind_id = case_when(
    grepl("CVTRIV", ind_id) ~ sub("^CV", "CV25", ind_id), 
    TRUE ~ ind_id
  ))
```

```{r}
info <- info %>%
  mutate(pool_name = "cvir-run014")
```

```{r}
info <- info %>%
  mutate(plate = case_when(
    extr_plate < 10 ~ as.character(str_pad(extr_plate,2,"left","0")), 
    extr_plate == 10 ~ as.character(extr_plate),
    extr_plate > 10 ~ as.character(extr_plate)
  )) %>%
  mutate(geno_id = paste(ind_id, plate, extr_well, sep = "-")) %>%
  mutate(geno_id = str_replace_all(geno_id, "_","-")) 

# Check if they are all correct format 

info %>%
  select(geno_id) %>%
  mutate(valid = str_detect(geno_id,
                            "^CV[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{4}-[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{2}-[A-H][0-9]{2}$")) %>%
  summarise(all_valid = all(valid))

# If false, find which ones failed
info %>%
  select(geno_id) %>%
  mutate(valid = str_detect(geno_id,
                            "^CV[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{4}-[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{2}-[A-H][0-9]{2}$")) %>%
  arrange(valid) %>%
  filter(valid == FALSE)
```

```{r}
info <- info %>%
  mutate(i7_index_name = paste0("GTseq-i7-i", str_pad(i7, 2, pad = "0")))
```

```{r}
info <- info %>%
  left_join(i7_indexes, by = "i7_index_name")
```

```{r}
info <- info %>%
    mutate(i5_index_name = paste0("GTseq-i5-i", str_pad(i5, 2, pad = "0"),"-IR1"))
```

```{r}
info <- info %>%
  left_join(i5_indexes, by = "i5_index_name")
```

We need to reverse complement all of our i5s!

```{r}
info <- info %>%
  mutate(
    i5_rev = as.character(
      Biostrings::reverseComplement(Biostrings::DNAStringSet(i5_index_sequence))
    )
  )

info %>%
  select(i5_index_sequence,i5_rev)
```

```{r}
info <- info %>%
  select(-i5_index_sequence) %>%
  rename(i5_index_sequence = i5_rev)
```

```{r}
final <- info %>%
  select(sample_num, pool_name, geno_id, i7_index_name,i7_index_sequence,i5_index_name,i5_index_sequence)
```

```{r}
write_csv(final, here::here("data","derived","example_sample_submission_data.csv"))
```
